data.long_meaning: Logesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'loga' meaning 'people' and 'ish' meaning 'God'. The name signifies the grace of God upon the people. In Hindu mythology, Logesh is the name of a deity who is believed to bestow divine blessings and protect his devotees. The name Logesh carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Logesh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Logesh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Logesh holds significant cultural significance for Hindus as it reflects the deep-rooted belief in the collective strength and wisdom of the people, along with the undying faith in the power and presence of God among them. This name upholds the Indian value system that places great importance on community and spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Logesh evokes feelings of divine protection and blessings. It signifies the belief that God is always with us and that his blessings can transform individuals and communities. For Hindus, the name is a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong spiritual connection with the divine, and seeking His guidance and support in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Logesh was a revered sage and a disciple of sage Agastya. He is mentioned in the Agastya Samhita, a text in ancient Indian literature that dates back to approximately 2000 BCE.

Logesh is also mentioned in the Skanda Purana, an important Hindu scripture, as a king of the Vidarbha region who ruled during the time of Lord Rama (circa 500 BCE). He is known for his devotion towards Lord Shiva and is said to have performed several penances to please the god.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Logesh continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
